_doc: The roofs of the town's centre, where the towers step back: a block standing on a lower roof. Proves the near and the far level paint a covered roof alike (the terrace's floor), keep its plant and machine rooms off the block above, and put a machine room on the same roof at every distance. Near (40 px a metre) and mid (12) aimed at the highest roof within 120 m of the centre (setViewRoof: the ground there is the streets, the roofs stand tens of metres over them), far (3) at the centre; four azimuths, from above and oblique, by day.
